title: bitsa_nlp@LT-EDI-ACL2022: Leveraging Pretrained Language Models for Detecting Homophobia and Transphobia in Social Media Comments

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of transformer-based pretrained language models (such as mBERT and XLM-RoBERTa) on a multiclass classification task to detect homophobic language in English, Tamil, and Tamil-English code-mixed YouTube comments.

Evaluating the performance of transformer-based pretrained language models (such as mBERT and XLM-RoBERTa) on a multiclass classification task to detect transphobic language in English, Tamil, and Tamil-English code-mixed YouTube comments.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
